newsitem.title: UK: Liverpool cotton sees fairly broad inquiry.
newsitem.headline: Liverpool cotton sees fairly broad inquiry.

text.p: Traders noted fairly broad inquiry for upland styles against shipment requirements extending through to the late autumn months, when the first lots from the northern hemisphere 1997/98 crops should become available.
A fair volume of business has been concluded in the popular Central Asian styles, filling gaps mainly near at hand.

Many sellers appear to be in a cautious mood regarding more distant shipment periods since they hold the view that better grades will be difficult to come by for this period and that prices will therefore be firm.
